name: Tesla Roadster Chase
desc:
Welcome to Tesla Roadster Chase! Steal the brand new Roadster right off the showroom stage and escape the police.

🏙️ Big city map with a highway, back roads and shortcuts
🚗 Fast, smooth driving built for weaving through traffic
🚓 Intense police chases with cops on your tail
💰 Earn cash to upgrade your Roadster's speed and style
🏆 Achievements, quests and way more

⚠️This is a fan-made game. We are not associated with Tesla or the Tesla Roadster

llm.loop: steal the Roadster -> escape police through the city -> earn cash -> upgrade speed and style
llm.objectives: escape police chases and upgrade the Roadster
llm.progression: cash, engine upgrades, skins/crates, achievements and quests
llm.instructions: steal the Roadster from the showroom and escape the police; earn cash to upgrade speed and style
unique: single licensed-style hero car (fan-made Tesla Roadster) as the whole game
llm.thumbnails: rendered futuristic Roadster with gull-wing doors flying over a wet highway with police cars behind, city skyline
llm.complexity_notes: big city map with highway, vehicle handling, police AI and traffic, upgrade/crate systems
